_comment: Engine third-party dependency manifest. Only engine-direct dependencies are listed. Vulkan SDK / volk / VulkanMemoryAllocator / glfw3 / fmt are intentionally NOT listed because they are pulled in transitively (Vulkan stack via OrangeRender's find_dependency, fmt via spdlog's bundled copy) and the engine itself does not consume their headers directly outside of the dedicated isolated source trees that already document each rule. stb 也不在本 manifest 里：上游仓库根目录没有 CMakeLists.txt，作者长期拒绝维护任何 CMake/package 文件；OrangeEngine 只用 stb_image_write.h，已作为 in-tree 单文件 vendor 落在 vendor/stb/stb_image_write.h（git tracked），由顶层 CMakeLists 以 BUILD_INTERFACE include 直接消费。

dependencies.name: spdlog
dependencies.purpose: Logging backend for Core::Log. Public headers do NOT include spdlog — the gate only switches the implementation in src/core/Log.cpp.

dependencies.name: glm
dependencies.purpose: Math types (Vec2/3/4, Mat3/4, Quat) appearing in public engine API

dependencies.name: glfw
dependencies.purpose: Window + raw input device backend. Wrapped by Platform::Window in src/platform/glfw/. Public engine API never exposes GLFWwindow*. (Also pulled in transitively via OrangeRender today; declaring it here so engine survives OrangeRender's future privatisation of its glfw link interface.)

dependencies.name: EnTT
dependencies.purpose: ECS registry. Component types appear in public engine API because the game registers its own components.

dependencies.name: nlohmann_json
dependencies.purpose: JSON backend for Core::Serialization::JsonReader / JsonWriter. Public API does not expose nlohmann::json types — see越界禁令 in docs/extension-points.md. version pin + JSON_BuildTests=OFF：默认分支 develop 上的 tests/src/unit-unicode1.cpp 在 MSVC + 非 UTF-8 代码页下会触发 C2143 语法错误；我们只用 header-only 部分，没必要跟着 develop 漂、也没必要编它的测试。

dependencies.name: Box2D
dependencies.purpose: 2D physics backend. Allowed only in src/physics/box2d/.

dependencies.name: miniaudio
dependencies.purpose: Cross-platform audio backend. Allowed only in src/audio/miniaudio/. Source repo provides CMakeLists which installs the single header — fetch 脚本走标准 cmake_install。

dependencies.name: Dear ImGui
dependencies.purpose: Immediate-mode GUI for editor / debug overlays. Phase 6 feature; integrated via GLFW + Vulkan backends. optional=true：上游仓库根目录没有官方 CMakeLists.txt（ocornut 长期拒绝），当前 cmake_install 模式跑不通；Dependencies.cmake 已把 imgui 当 soft dep (find_package CONFIG QUIET) 处理，没装也不阻断 engine 构建。编辑器侧真正落 imgui 集成时改 mode=vendor_clone 由 OrangeEngine 自编，并在 cmake/Dependencies.cmake 改为 in-tree add_library 路径——届时再启用此条目。

dependencies.name: DragonBonesCPP
dependencies.purpose: 2D skeletal animation runtime. 仓根没 CMakeLists（多平台子目录形态），走 in-tree 源码集成：注册为 git submodule（.gitmodules），由 orange_engine 自己编 vendor/DragonBones/DragonBones/src/dragonBones/*.cpp 进静态库。fetch 脚本走 git submodule update --init 同步。Allowed only in src/animation/dragonbones/. C++ runtime maintenance is a known risk; abstraction layer in include/orange/engine/animation/IAnimator.h preserves the option to swap backends.
